```yaml
name: sccache warmup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # midnight UTC

jobs:
  warmup:
    name: Warm up sccache cache
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-arm64, windows-latest, macos-latest, macos-arm64]
    env:
      # GCS bucket configuration for sccache
      SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: walrus-sccache
      SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET_REGION: us-west1
      SCCACHE_GCS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}
      # Disable sccache annotations to keep logs clean
      SCCACHE_DISABLE_ANNOTATIONS: "true"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Set up sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.9
        with:
          version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable_annotations: true

      - name: Build debug (workspace)
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        run: cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"

      - name: Build release
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Show sccache stats
        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request || !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
        run: sccache --show-stats

      - name: Notify failure to sui-operations
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.SUI_OPERATIONS_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            await github.repos.createDispatchEvent({
              owner: 'MystenLabs',
              repo: 'sui-operations',
              event_type: 'sccache-warmup-failure',
              client_payload: {
                workflow: 'sccache-warmup',
                job: '${{ github.job }}',
                run_id: '${{ github.run_id }}',
                os: '${{ matrix.os }}',
                status: 'failure'
              }
            })
```
